extract_batch with mixed valid and missing URI inputs

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="text/plain.txt"), ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="/nonexistent/missing.pdf")]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
